posts.name: Jeysie
posts.cooked:
Phantom5613:

I had a couple thoughts on this EN, but I can't remember everything. Maybe I'll relisten to get a reminder.

I'm eternally grateful for WalkingTarget's summaries as I am pants at remembering aural information versus written information. ^^;

Phantom5613:

I would consider donatiing to a patreon for the podcast, but I'm both wary of things that auto-take money from my account(I always pay bills in cash when it's possible) and I want to wait to see what their pledge levels are.

I have a person I've supported on Patreon for a couple years now and haven't had any issues, FWIW.

Re: What else they could cover: Rounding out the "main" episodes: I definitely agree with a Starter Kit podcast; I'd love to see some things fleshed out like the background of some of the areas and getting more into the heads and personalities of the various NPC heroes post-OblivAeon. (Especially Marty, who we currently know very little about personality-wise.) I also like the idea of a podcast about Beacon, as well as suggestions about some current significant characters like Heartbreaker that people have wanted to know more about.

For future episodes: If they just gave us episodes full of more of the issue blow-by-blow summaries it would make me so happy. Also it'd be great to get more followups as we see more RPG-related stuff, as well as Prime War when it shows up.

Re: The Editor's Note topics:

Am I the only one who squeed a little at the whole "they dressed up in Wild West outfits" bit? Like, mental images of Nightmist and Argent and Tempest in Wild West outfits are the best thing ever, you can't convince me otherwise.

I admit I honestly wouldn't blink twice if Hugh and Nigel were just naked other than their projected clothing since there are Marvel characters where that literally is the case for them.

Judge Mental being a rival lawyer to Cosmic is honestly pretty morbidly hilarious. Especially with the implication that the dislike/rivalry is pretty one-sided.
